bullets: * REGULAR STRENGTH 325mg ASPIRIN [NSAID]: Globe Aspirin offers 325mg of pure aspirin per tablet which is the optimal amount for everyday aches and pains. Just the recommended, regular-strength dose any adult or teenager can fully benefit from. NSAID - nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug. Compare to the active ingredient of Bayer Aspirin.

EASY TO TAKE WITH YOU: Keep Globe Aspirin 325mg Packets in your secured medicine closet, first aid kit, car, camping bag, and even your travel carryon luggage. The convenience of these packets allows you to take them anywhere.
PAIN RELIEF: Use Aspirin to temporarily relieve minor aches and pains due to headache, muscular aches, arthritis, toothache, backache, the common cold and menstrual cramps.

* COMPARE TO: Globe Aspirin 325mg tablets are compared to Genuine Bayer Aspirin. Each Tablet contains Regular Strength Aspirin at 325 mg, offering a comparable formulation for pain relief and fever reduction at a much lower cost.

QUALITY: Manufactured in accordance with the highest pharmaceutical manufacturing processes and contains a NDC for 100% confidence. Made in the USA. Trifecta Pharmaceuticals USA is a family business based in sunny Fort Lauderdale, Florida USA.
